scope: Proposition 7.4 (Uniform local conditional comparison) of the manuscript “Quenched SLE₃ Universality for the Weak Random-Bond Ising Model” (preprints/Quenched-SLE3-Universality-for-the-Weak-Random-Bond-Ising-Model-October-5-2026/quenched-sle3-weak-random-bond-ising.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbf1578546653fc5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a bounded polygonal geometry with a finite family T of corridor crossings, band circuits, or the three annular passage checks strictly inside its free buffers; annular windows may have both an inner and an outer free collar. Dilate this geometry by r in lattice units, where r → ∞. There is a nonnegative envelope Er(η), independent of exterior Gibbs data, such that EEr → 0, uniformly in the translated center and the position of the scale grids. For every exterior assignment the quenched joint test law is within Er(η) in total variation of a mixture of pure conditional test laws on a still-buffered interior window. Consequently every positive pure lower bound uniform over those conditional laws transfers with any strictly smaller bound, outside an environment event whose probability tends to zero.
